records.title: Revisiting On-Policy Distillation: Empirical Failure Modes and Simple Fixes
records.reason: Its primary abstract centers on the training signal for on-policy distillation; it does not propose an inference-time compute, memory, or latency change.

records.title: A Dataset for Answering Time-Sensitive Questions
records.reason: The paper contributes data and task evaluation. Its use of “inference” describes predicting answer spans within a QA model, not improving LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: Software-hardware co-design for fast and scalable training of deep learning recommendation models
records.reason: The abstract expressly targets distributed training of DLRMs; no LLM inference or serving work is described.

records.title: VLABench: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Language-Conditioned Robotics Manipulation with Long-Horizon Reasoning Tasks
records.reason: It contributes evaluation tasks/data for robotics, not an inference-efficiency method.

records.title: Scalable Deep Learning on Distributed Infrastructures
records.reason: The primary abstract describes distributed infrastructure for deep-learning performance at scale; it does not establish an LLM-serving optimization or inference-specific method.
